entries.partTitle: Matter Protocol Architecture: Unified IP Application Layer over Thread & Wi-Fi

spec.title: Matter Protocol Architecture: Unified IP Appl... — Register Bit Architecture

steps.caption: Step 1: Initialize IOT_NET_CR1 with EN bit asserted (0x80) [D4P1].
Step 2: Peripheral asserts RDY & IRQ flags (0xE0) on IOT_NET_CR1.
Step 3: Enable DMA burst & CRC verification bits (0xF8).
Step 4: Full TX/RX frame committed with ERR=0 verified (0xFE).
